title: There Should Exist The Tetradic Nontrivial Zeros Off The Critical Line
content: In the manuscript [1] that led to his epoch-making paper "On the Number of Primes Less Than a Given Magnitude" [2], Bernhard Riemann had already revealed the Reciprocal Sum Formula for all of the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function. We leverage this formula to prove the proposition that is our paper's title.
